learn.hook: Roti, dal, rice, sabzi, curd... Where does all this food come from?
points: We get food from plants and from animals.
From plants we get cereals (rice, wheat), millets (ragi, jowar, bajra), pulses (dal), fruits, vegetables and oils.
From animals we get milk, curd, paneer, eggs, honey, fish and meat.
Some families eat only plant foods and milk. Others also eat eggs, fish or meat. All these are choices families make.
Millets are healthy grains grown in India. The year 2023 was celebrated as the International Year of Millets.

example.q: Paneer is white and soft. Does it come from a plant or an animal?
steps: Paneer is made by curdling milk.
Milk comes from animals like cows and buffaloes.
So paneer is a food we get from animals.
example.answer: From an animal (it is made from milk)

learn.reallife: At your next meal, look at your plate and sort each item: did it come from a plant or an animal?

quiz.q: Which of these do we get from animals?
quiz.explain: Milk comes from animals like cows, buffaloes and goats.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up plant and animal foods

quiz.q: Honey is made by which creature?
quiz.explain: Bees make honey from the nectar of flowers.
quiz.mistake: Does not know where honey comes from

quiz.q: Which of these is a millet?
quiz.explain: Ragi is a millet. Jowar and bajra are millets too.
quiz.mistake: Does not know what millets are

quiz.q: Rice and wheat are ___.
quiz.explain: Rice and wheat are cereal grains that give us energy.
quiz.mistake: Does not know the word cereal

quiz.q: Which of these is a pulse?
quiz.explain: Pulses are dals like chana, moong, masoor and arhar.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up pulses and vegetables

quiz.q: The year 2023 was celebrated as the International Year of ___.
quiz.explain: 2023 was the International Year of Millets, to make people aware of these healthy grains.
quiz.mistake: Guesses a popular food

quiz.q: Curd is made from ___.
quiz.explain: When a little curd is added to warm milk and left for some hours, the milk sets into curd.
quiz.mistake: Does not know how curd is made

quiz.q: Which food comes from a plant?
quiz.explain: Peanuts are seeds of the groundnut plant, which grow under the soil.
quiz.mistake: Thinks peanuts come from animals because they are rich food

teach.ask: Gappu only eats seeds. He asks: where does the food on your plate come from?
teach.praise: Chirp! Plants and animals both feed us!

learn.hook: A potato can be boiled, fried, roasted or baked. One food, so many tastes!
points: Some foods are eaten raw, like fruits, cucumbers and carrots in a salad.
Boiling: cooking in hot bubbling water, like rice, dal and eggs.
Frying: cooking in hot oil, like puris, pakoras and samosas.
Steaming: cooking with steam from boiling water, like idlis, dhoklas and modaks.
Roasting cooks food over a flame, like bhutta, and baking cooks food in an oven, like bread and cake. Cooking is always done by or with an adult!

example.q: Idli batter is poured into moulds and kept over boiling water in a closed pot. The idlis never touch the water. How are they cooked?
steps: The food does not sit in the water, so it is not boiled.
There is no oil, so it is not fried.
The hot steam rising from the water cooks the idlis. This is steaming.

learn.reallife: Watch an adult cook at home and name the cooking method used for each dish. Never use the stove on your own.

items.text: Bread and cake are cooked in an oven. This is ___.
Bhutta is cooked over burning coal. This is ___.
Jalebis are cooked in hot oil. This is ___.

quiz.q: How are puris cooked?
quiz.explain: Puris puff up when fried in hot oil.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up frying and boiling

quiz.q: How is dhokla cooked?
quiz.explain: Dhokla batter is cooked in steam, which makes it soft and spongy.
quiz.mistake: Does not know what steaming is

quiz.q: Which food is cooked by boiling?
quiz.explain: Rice is cooked in boiling water until it is soft.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up cooking methods

quiz.q: Which of these can be eaten raw?
quiz.explain: Washed cucumbers are eaten raw in salads. Rajma, rice and flour must be cooked.
quiz.mistake: Thinks all vegetables and grains can be eaten raw

quiz.q: Bread and cake are cooked in an oven. What is this method called?
quiz.explain: Cooking in the dry heat of an oven is called baking.
quiz.mistake: Does not know the word baking

quiz.q: Why should children not use the stove on their own?
options: Fire and hot oil can cause burns
quiz.explain: Fire, hot pans and hot oil can burn us. Cooking must be done by or with an adult.
quiz.mistake: Does not think about safety in the kitchen

quiz.q: Why do we wash fruits before eating them raw?
quiz.explain: Washing removes dust, dirt and germs from the skin of fruits.
quiz.mistake: Thinks fruits are always clean

quiz.q: Bhutta (corn) is often cooked over hot coals. What is this method?
quiz.explain: Cooking food directly over a flame or hot coals is roasting.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up roasting and baking

teach.ask: Gappu sees idlis, puris and boiled eggs. He asks: are all foods cooked the same way?
teach.praise: Tweet! Boil, fry, steam, roast, bake — so many ways!

learn.hook: Travel across India on a plate! Every state has its own yummy dishes.
points: People in different parts of India eat different foods, based on what grows there and their customs.
In many parts of north India, wheat rotis are common. In many parts of south and east India, rice is eaten more.
Punjab: makki di roti with sarson da saag. Gujarat: dhokla. Rajasthan: dal baati churma. Bihar: litti chokha.
Tamil Nadu: idli and dosa. Kerala: puttu and appam. Maharashtra: puran poli and vada pav.
People living near the sea, like in Goa and Kerala, often eat fish and use coconut in cooking.

example.q: Why do many dishes in Kerala use coconut?
steps: Kerala lies along the sea coast.
Coconut trees grow in large numbers there.
Food that grows nearby is used often in local cooking.
example.answer: Because a lot of coconut trees grow in Kerala

learn.reallife: Ask a friend from another state about a favourite dish from home. Maybe you can share tiffins!

games.title: Dish and its state
pairs: Makki di roti and sarson da saag

games.title: Food around India
items: Idli and dosa are popular in Tamil Nadu.
They are made from a batter of rice and urad dal.
Dhokla is a famous dish of Gujarat.
It is a soft, steamed snack.
Coconut is used a lot in Kerala's cooking.
Many coconut trees grow in Kerala.
Every Indian state eats exactly the same food.
Each region has its own dishes, based on its crops and customs.
Litti chokha is a famous dish of Bihar.
Litti are wheat dough balls stuffed with sattu, eaten with chokha.

quiz.q: Dhokla is a famous dish from which state?
quiz.explain: Dhokla is a steamed snack from Gujarat.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up dishes of different states

quiz.q: Which dish is popular in Punjab?
options: Makki di roti and sarson da saag
quiz.explain: Makki di roti (maize roti) with sarson da saag (mustard greens) is a winter favourite in Punjab.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up north and south Indian dishes

quiz.q: Litti chokha is a famous dish of which state?
quiz.explain: Litti chokha is a well-known dish of Bihar.
quiz.mistake: Guesses a state without knowing

quiz.q: Why do people in different places eat different foods?
options: Everyone eats only what is on TV
Different crops grow in different places, and customs differ
quiz.explain: People cook with what grows near them, like rice in wet areas and coconut on coasts.
quiz.mistake: Thinks food choices have no reason

quiz.q: People living near the sea often eat a lot of ___.
quiz.explain: Fish is easy to get near the sea, so it is common in coastal food.
quiz.mistake: Does not link where people live with what they eat

quiz.q: Idli and dosa are made from a batter of rice and ___.
quiz.explain: Idli and dosa batter is made by grinding soaked rice and urad dal.
quiz.mistake: Does not know what idli is made from

quiz.q: Dal baati churma is a famous dish from which state?
quiz.explain: Dal baati churma comes from Rajasthan.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up dishes of different states

quiz.q: Puttu, a steamed rice dish, is popular in which state?
quiz.explain: Puttu, often eaten with kadala curry, is a favourite breakfast in Kerala.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up dishes of different states

teach.ask: Gappu flew across India and found new foods everywhere. He asks: why do different places eat different foods?
teach.praise: Chirp! Every place cooks with what grows nearby!
teach.nudge: Can you name a dish from another state?
